ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) field with high-intensity (white) pixels localized primarily in distal clusters and sparse punctate spots; estimated ratio of 95:5.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform low-intensity dark field across the macro-surface; high-contrast white pixel clusters at both the left and right distal tips; sparse, non-contiguous white punctate spots distributed randomly across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped central depression with a narrow vertex angle approximately 40-50 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular macro-serrations on the right lobe trailing edge consisting of approximately 8-10 distinct peaks; left lobe trailing edge displays lower-amplitude, smoother topographic variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge leading to acute, upward-pointing distal apices.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast circular white pixel aggregates localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; scattered individual circular white spots across the central dark region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent thin, white linear mark on the left lobe surface oriented diagonally; multiple shorter, low-contrast linear disruptions on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation at both distal tips, manifesting as raised white-on-black textured masses; associated dark reddish-brown pixel clusters indicative of organic growth/algae on the barnacle sites.
other_distinctive_markers: The lower portion of the central notch and the leading edge are occluded by the water-surface interface; asymmetric barnacle volume with a larger cluster visible on the right lobe tip.
